mapper.select: SELECT id FROM events WHERE id = #{eventId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.id AS application_id, a.event_id, a.user_id, a.status, e.application_deadline <= now() AS deadline_passed FROM applications a JOIN events e ON e.id = a.event_id WHERE a.event_id = #{eventId} AND a.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT my.status, CASE WHEN my.status = 'waitlisted' THEN ( SELECT count(*)::int FROM applications w WHERE w.event_id = my.event_id AND w.status = 'waitlisted' AND (w.applied_at, w.id) <= (my.applied_at, my.id) ) END AS waitlist_position, my.applied_at FROM applications my WHERE my.event_id = #{eventId} AND my.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO applications (event_id, user_id, status, applied_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{userId}, #{status}, clock_timestamp())
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE event_id = #{eventId}

SELECT a.user_id, u.nickname, a.status, CASE WHEN a.status = 'waitlisted' THEN (row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.status ORDER BY a.applied_at, a.id))::int END AS waitlist_position, a.applied_at FROM applications a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY CASE a.status WHEN 'applied' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, a.applied_at, a.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE applications SET status = 'applied' WHERE id IN ( SELECT w.id FROM applications w WHERE w.event_id = #{eventId} AND w.status = 'waitlisted' ORDER BY w.applied_at, w.id LIMIT GREATEST( (SELECT capacity FROM events WHERE id = #{eventId}) - (SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'applied'), 0) ) AND (SELECT application_deadline FROM events WHERE id = #{eventId}) > now()
